testimonials.name: Dana R.
testimonials.body: Drove down from Sea Isle on the Saturday of the Memorial Day event and left with a lifted six-passenger. The battery year was printed right on the listing, which is why I called this dealer first instead of the three closer to me.

testimonials.name: Marcus T.
testimonials.body: Bought two street-legal carts for a rental property. 0% for 48 months made it an easy decision, and both were titled and tagged before I picked them up.

testimonials.name: Ellen K.
testimonials.body: I wanted lithium and nothing else, and they had eleven of them on the floor. The salesman talked me out of a bigger pack than I needed rather than into one.

testimonials.name: Ray P.
testimonials.body: Traded a fifteen-year-old gas cart against a used electric. Trade value stacked on top of the event price, which I did not expect and did not have to argue about.

testimonials.name: Sofia M.
testimonials.body: Good price and a straight deal on a utility cart for the ranch. Delivery took a week longer than quoted, but they called me before I had to call them.

testimonials.name: Greg A.
testimonials.body: Six carts for a campground fleet. They sourced the two extra I needed inside of a fortnight and matched the event pricing on all six.
